description: A Brickadia dedicated server run through Omegga, a server wrapper, automator, and plugin runner. Omegga adds a plugin API for JavaScript, TypeScript, and anything that speaks JSON-RPC, and serves a web interface for the console, players, plugins, and saves. Brickadia is installed with SteamCMD, and Omegga updates it in place from there, saving and restoring the server around the restart.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Brickadia (Omegga) Installation Script
#
# Server Files: /mnt/server
#
# Omegga is a node application that installs and runs Brickadia itself, so this
# installs node and omegga, then hands the game over to omegga. It updates the
# game the same way once the server is running, saving and restoring the server
# around the restart.

##
#
# Variables
# NODE_VERSION: node release to install, from https://nodejs.org/dist
# OMEGGA_VERSION: npm version or tag of omegga to install
#
 ##

set -eo pipefail

# omegga resolves its config dir, data/, and plugins/ relative to $HOME and the
# working directory, so both have to point at the mounted volume.
export HOME=/mnt/server
cd /mnt/server

## install node, which no installer image ships
echo -e "Installing node v${NODE_VERSION}\n"
curl -sSL -o node.tar.gz "https://nodejs.org/dist/v${NODE_VERSION}/node-v${NODE_VERSION}-linux-x64.tar.gz"
mkdir -p node
tar -xzf node.tar.gz -C node --strip-components=1
rm node.tar.gz
export PATH=/mnt/server/node/bin:${PATH}

## install omegga
echo -e "Installing omegga@${OMEGGA_VERSION}\n"
npm_config_cache=/mnt/server/.npm-install npm install --no-audit --no-fund --prefix /mnt/server "omegga@${OMEGGA_VERSION}"
rm -rf /mnt/server/.npm-install

## omegga writes these on the first start; writing the config here makes it
## editable from the file manager before that
if [ -f omegga-config.yml ]; then
    echo "omegga-config.yml already exists, leaving it alone"
else
    cat > omegga-config.yml <<'YML'
omegga:
  webui: true
  https: true
  port: 8080
server:
  port: 7777
  map: Plate
YML
fi
mkdir -p plugins data/Saved/Builds

## omegga installs SteamCMD and the game itself, and updates them the same way
## once the server is running
echo -e "Installing Brickadia\n"
./node_modules/.bin/omegga download

## install end
echo "-----------------------------------------"
echo "Installation completed..."
echo "-----------------------------------------"

variables.name: Brickadia hosting token
variables.description: Server hosting token, generated at https://brickadia.com/account/tokens. Required: without one the server has nothing to authenticate with and stops on start.

variables.name: Omegga web UI port
variables.description: Port for Omegga's web interface. This must be a SECOND allocation assigned to this server on the Network tab: the primary allocation is Brickadia's game port, and Brickadia reports its configured port to the master server, so the two cannot share a number.

variables.name: Omegga version
variables.description: npm version or tag of Omegga to install, e.g. latest or 1.16.1.

variables.name: Update Omegga on boot
variables.description: Install the configured Omegga version from npm on every start. Turn this off to keep the copy in the server's node_modules, which also lets the server start while npm is unreachable. Brickadia updates are Omegga's own and are unaffected either way.

variables.name: Extra Omegga flags
variables.description: Extra flags appended to the omegga command. Leave empty for normal operation. --update checks Steam for a Brickadia update on every start, --verbose prints extra messages for debugging, --debug prints all console logs rather than just chat. Use this rather than the BRICKADIA_DEBUG environment variable: Omegga treats that one as set-or-unset.

variables.name: Node version
variables.description: Node release installed into the server, from https://nodejs.org/dist. Omegga needs v23 or newer. Changing this takes effect on the next reinstall.

variables.name: Steam App ID
variables.description: Brickadia's Steam app ID, read by both the install script and Omegga.

variables.name: Skip SteamCMD prompt
variables.description: Must stay "true". The install script provides SteamCMD, but if it is ever missing Omegga asks before downloading its own, which the console cannot answer.

variables.name: Non-interactive
variables.description: Must stay "true". Wings gives the container a terminal, so Omegga cannot tell on its own that this console submits whole lines and can never answer an arrow-key prompt. Without it Omegga waits at the authentication prompt until the startup timeout instead of exiting with the token URL.

variables.name: Enable metrics
variables.description: Serve the Prometheus metrics endpoint. Needs a third allocation matching the metrics port below.

variables.name: Metrics bind address
variables.description: Address the metrics endpoint binds to. Must be 0.0.0.0 to be reachable from outside the container; 127.0.0.1 keeps it container-local.

variables.name: Metrics port
variables.description: Port for the Prometheus metrics endpoint, when metrics are enabled.
